title: Spiced Lamb and Sumac Tortilla Pizzas with Minted Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Warm wholemeal tortillas replace the yeast dough, and they are spread with minted cucumber yoghurt, then topped with sumac and cumin spiced lamb, chopped tomato and coriander instead of tomato sauce and mozzarella.
summary: Spiced lamb on warm tortillas offset by creamy yoghurt, cool cucumber and fresh herbs, finished with ripe tomato.

ingredients.item: lamb mince (or trimmed leg of lamb, minced)
fine sea salt or table salt
small cucumbers, cut into small cubes

steps.title: Brown onion
steps.text: Heat a large non-stick frying pan until very hot, lower to medium-high, add 5 ml oil and cook the 1 finely chopped medium onion until it begins to brown at the edges.

steps.title: Season and cook
steps.text: Mix the 225 g lamb mince with 1 minced garlic clove, 1 tsp sumac, ⅛ tsp chilli flakes, ¼ tsp cumin, ⅛ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper; add to the onion, breaking it apart with a spoon, and cook until fully browned and reaching 71 °C on an instant-read thermometer.

steps.title: Prepare yoghurt
steps.text: Cut 115 g small unpeeled cucumbers into small cubes, chop 2 tbsp fresh mint and 4 tbsp fresh coriander (reserve half the coriander), then fold the cucumber, mint and half the coriander into 245 g plain yoghurt.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.text: Heat 2 of the 4 wholemeal tortillas (about 20 cm each) either over a low gas flame or wrapped in foil in a 200 °C oven for roughly 3 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare toppings
steps.text: Slice the 2 medium-large ripe tomatoes and cut them into small wedges.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread one quarter of the yoghurt mixture onto each warm tortilla, top with one quarter of the cooked lamb, one quarter of the tomato wedges and a scatter of the remaining coriander, then repeat the process with the remaining 2 tortillas.

tips: Warm the tortillas just before assembling so they stay soft and pliable.
If the yoghurt is very runny, drain it in a sieve for 10 minutes so the tortillas do not turn soggy.
safety: Cook the lamb to 71 °C using an instant-read thermometer to ensure it is fully cooked and food-safe
storage: Place leftovers in a sealed container and refrigerate within 2 hours; they keep for 2 days.
